sentences.en: And at the very same time, we were talking about her.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，我们也在讨论她。

sentences.en: And I don't really know who reached out to who firSt.
sentences.zh: 我其实不太清楚是谁先联系的谁。

sentences.en: I worked with Amy like a million years ago on another show.
sentences.zh: 我很久以前在另一部剧里和艾米合作过。

sentences.en: And we knew each other.
sentences.zh: 我们认识。

sentences.en: And I was all for it.
sentences.zh: 所以我完全支持这件事。

sentences.en: I loved working with her both times.
sentences.zh: 这两次与她合作我都非常愉快。

sentences.en: So we didn't know how much of an arc was it going to be with Amy.
sentences.zh: 所以我们当时并不知道艾米的戏份会有多长。

sentences.en: We didn't really know.
sentences.zh: 我们真的不知道。

sentences.en: We didn't have this kind of long-term deal.
sentences.zh: 我们没有签那种长期合约。

sentences.en: We wanted to kind of test it out and see because you never know about chemistry, right?
sentences.zh: 我们想先试一试，看看效果，因为你永远不知道化学反应会怎样，对吧？

sentences.en: You never know if she's going to have chemistry with Steve.

sentences.en: And she sure did.
sentences.zh: 而她确实做到了。

sentences.en: I don't think we knew that this was going to be the, you know, love of his life.

sentences.en: We hadn't planned it that far ahead.
sentences.zh: 我们没打算规划那么远。

sentences.en: We were also watching what happened and reacting to it.
sentences.zh: 我们当时也是边看边根据情况做出反应。

sentences.en: Can you believe that she said The Office?

sentences.en: I mean, she did this interview where she said she had been doing these heavy dramas.

sentences.en: And she really wanted to lighten things up.
sentences.zh: 她真的很想让氛围轻松一点。

sentences.en: She wanted to do a comedy.
sentences.zh: 她想演一部喜剧。

sentences.en: So that's what she told her agent she wanted to do.

sentences.zh: 看这一集的时候我感动得哽咽了。

sentences.zh: 每当她回应他的爱意或者稍微调情一下的时候。

sentences.zh: 我是说，我真为迈克尔感到高兴，终于有个女人对他这么好。

sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们现在其实也还在用这种耳塞式的东西。

sentences.zh: 但那时候，伙计们，那些东西简直巨大。

sentences.zh: 这是老式科技预警。

sentences.en: Jim explains that Dwight left his cell phone on his desk.
sentences.zh: 吉姆解释说德怀特把手机落在桌子上了。

sentences.en: So naturally, he paired it to his headset.
sentences.zh: 所以很自然地，他就把它和自己的耳机配对了。

sentences.en: But it goes on.
sentences.zh: 但这还没完。

sentences.en: Dwight's like, fine.
sentences.zh: 德怀特心想，好吧。

sentences.zh: 那我就重新设置我的手机，让它转接到我的办公桌电话上。

sentences.zh: 他把德怀特的办公桌电话转接到了他自己的办公桌电话上。

sentences.en: You know, I'm probably going to get some hate for this, but it does make me feel like Ryan was correct in sort of calling Jim out on his productivity.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我可能会因为这么说而招黑，但这确实让我觉得瑞安在某种程度上指责吉姆的工作效率是有道理的。

sentences.en: Because look at all the effort he went into this whole like earpiece prank.
sentences.zh: 因为看看他在这个耳机恶作剧上花了多少精力。

sentences.en: And he probably could have made some sales during this time.
sentences.zh: 他本来可以在这段时间里完成一些销售额的。

sentences.en: Here's what I want to say about that, because I worked in corporate America for a long time.
sentences.zh: 关于这一点我想说的是，因为我在美国企业界工作了很长时间。

sentences.en: And I often felt like I could get all of my work done in about five hours, but I was required to sit there for eight.
sentences.zh: 我经常觉得我可以在五个小时内完成所有的工作，但我却被要求坐在那里八个小时。

sentences.en: I mean, sometimes you can get what needs to be done faster than the company has allotted.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，有时候你完成必要工作的时间比公司分配的时间要短。

sentences.en: And so I think that was the case with Jim.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为吉姆的情况就是这样。

sentences.en: I think he does very good in sales.
sentences.zh: 我觉得他的销售业绩做得很好。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I guess Ryan was like, what if you really spent those extra hours making sales?
sentences.zh: 我猜瑞安当时的想法是，如果你真的把那些额外的时间花在做销售上会怎样？

sentences.en: But I don't know.
sentences.zh: 但我不知道。

sentences.en: He's getting it done.
sentences.zh: 他把工作完成了。

sentences.en: And he's, I mean, sometimes I feel like these work hours are rather arbitrary.
sentences.zh: 而且，我的意思是，有时候我觉得这些工作时间相当武断。

sentences.en: How about work until your work is done and then go home and enjoy your life?
sentences.zh: 为什么不工作到任务完成，然后回家享受生活呢？

sentences.en: I like that.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这个主意。

sentences.en: Jenna, you sound like some upstart company where you're like, here's the thing.
sentences.zh: 珍娜，你听起来就像那种初创公司，你会说，事情是这样的。

sentences.zh: 另外，我们在大厅里放了个肥皂箱，如果你在一天中的任何时候需要发表什么声明，随时可以站上去。

sentences.zh: 你知道那个供应商名单刚才发生了什么吗？

sentences.en: Oh, someone shredded it.
sentences.zh: 哦，有人把它碎掉了。

sentences.en: Just now.
sentences.zh: 就在刚才。

sentences.en: And Phyllis is like, why would you do that?
sentences.zh: 菲利斯问，你为什么要那样做？

sentences.en: And Angela says, why do you think?
sentences.zh: 安吉拉说，你觉得呢？

sentences.en: Yeah, I just don't know.
sentences.zh: 是啊，我就是不知道。

sentences.en: Oh, so good, Angela.
sentences.zh: 哦，太棒了，安吉拉。

sentences.en: You're so good in that scene.
sentences.zh: 你在那场戏里演得真好。

sentences.en: And then Phyllis knocks the papers off of Angela's desk.
sentences.zh: 然后菲利斯把安吉拉桌上的文件扫到了地上。

sentences.en: I have two things to share.
sentences.zh: 我有两件事要分享。

sentences.en: First of all, that whole scene was in the script.
sentences.zh: 首先，整场戏都在剧本里。

sentences.en: And Phyllis knocking the papers off the desk.
sentences.zh: 还有菲利斯把桌上的文件扫到地上那段。

sentences.en: I wanted to see if that was in the script.
sentences.zh: 我想看看那是不是剧本里写的。

sentences.en: It was.
sentences.zh: 确实是。

sentences.en: So that was all written out.
sentences.zh: 所以那都是写好的。

sentences.en: But I wanted to share something with you guys.
sentences.zh: 但我有个事想和大家分享。

sentences.en: I remember when we rehearsed the scene, because you know, you guys, we would rehearse for camera
sentences.zh: 我记得我们排练那场戏的时候，因为你们知道，我们要为摄像机排练

sentences.en: so they would know where to line up their shots, right?
sentences.zh: 这样他们才知道镜头该怎么摆，对吧？

sentences.en: When Phyllis said to me in the rehearsal, can I get a list of your vendors?
sentences.zh: 当菲利斯在排练时对我说，能给我一份你的供应商名单吗？

sentences.en: I'm supposed to bend over quickly, hold the basket up and say, I shredded it.
sentences.zh: 我本该迅速弯下腰，举起篮子说，我把它碎掉了。

sentences.en: There was no quickly about it.
sentences.zh: 根本快不起来。

sentences.en: I was very pregnant.
sentences.zh: 当时我怀孕很明显了。

sentences.en: I couldn't reach the basket.
sentences.zh: 我够不到那个篮子。

sentences.en: They sat on the ground easily.
sentences.zh: 他们轻而易举地坐在地上。

sentences.en: So I was like, and then they're like, okay, that's not going to do.
sentences.zh: 所以我当时就说，然后他们就说，好吧，那样不行。

sentences.en: We can't see you struggling to reach the garbage bin, right?
sentences.zh: 我们不能看着你费劲地去够垃圾桶，对吧？

sentences.en: So Matt Soane, who was so sweet, who was our camera operator, he was like, let's just set
sentences.zh: 所以非常贴心的摄像师Matt Soane就说，不如把它放在

sentences.en: it on an Apple box.
sentences.zh: 一个苹果箱上。

sentences.en: You won't see it.
sentences.zh: 这样你就看不到了。

sentences.en: So Angela doesn't have to bend all the way down to the floor.
sentences.zh: 这样Angela就不必弯腰弯到地上了。

sentences.en: So if you watch the scene, I have that basket so ready to go.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你看那个场景，我会发现那个篮子已经准备就绪了。

sentences.en: It's because I don't even have to bend over to reach it.
sentences.zh: 那是因为我根本不需要弯腰去够它。

sentences.en: It's right there.
sentences.zh: 它就在那儿。

sentences.en: Yes, I was very pregnant, guys.
sentences.zh: 没错，伙计们，我当时怀孕很明显了。

sentences.en: This is something that comes up for Jenna and I as we rewatch these episodes.
sentences.zh: 这是Jen和我重温这些剧集时会谈到的事情。

sentences.en: There's real life that meets the fiction, right?
sentences.zh: 现实生活与虚构情节交织在一起，对吧？

sentences.en: All of the memories of what you had to go through to make these scenes work.
sentences.zh: 所有为了让这些场景顺利拍摄而经历的记忆。

sentences.en: To pick up a trash bin when you're super pregnant.
sentences.zh: 比如在怀孕后期还要去捡垃圾桶。

sentences.en: Well, now we cut back to Michael and Holly's kind of still working on the chair and Toby
sentences.zh: 好了，现在镜头切回Michael和Holly，他们还在弄椅子，这时Toby

sentences.zh: 走了过来，Michael得想办法打发走Toby。

sentences.zh: 他说，你为什么不先回家，等派对开始再回来呢？

sentences.zh: 但Toby说，好吧，我们还得进行我的离职面谈。

sentences.en: All right, guys, Michael has a talking head.
sentences.zh: 好了，各位，Michael有一个单人访谈。

sentences.en: He says, he's been steeped in anticipation of this moment.
sentences.zh: 他说，他一直沉浸在对这一刻的期待中。

sentences.en: Toby has been, quote, cruising for a bruising for 12 years.
sentences.zh: Toby，引用他的话，这十二年来一直在“自讨苦吃”。

sentences.en: And my name is Captain Bruising.
sentences.zh: 而我就是“苦头队长”。

sentences.en: The look on Michael's face says it all.
sentences.zh: Michael脸上的表情说明了一切。

sentences.en: He has been waiting for this moment for a long time.
sentences.zh: 他等这一刻已经等了很久了。

sentences.en: And he can't wait.
sentences.zh: 他已经迫不及待了。

sentences.en: I'm sorry to tell you that we're going to stop here.
sentences.zh: 很抱歉告诉大家，我们今天就讲到这里。

sentences.en: You will have to wait for this exit interview.
sentences.zh: 你们得等下一次才能看到这段离职面谈。

sentences.zh: 我超爱这一集。
